newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA'S TEN 96/97 YR EBIT UP 10 PCT.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA'S TEN 96/97 YR EBIT UP 10 PCT.

text.p: The Ten Group Ltd reported earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) of A$154.5 million for the year to June 30, 1997, a rise of 11 percent on the 1995/96 year.
The unlisted TEN said profit before tax, but excluding interest on subordinated debentures, was A$146.9 million for 1996/97, up 12.8 percent excluding the abnormal gain in the prior year.
TEN said interest expense was A$7.6 million excludes interest on the A$45.5 million of subordinated debentures.

It said the 1996/97 results were for a 53 week period, while the previous year was for 52 weeks. The results also include a 12 month contribution from Adelaide and Perth TEN affiliated stations acquired during the 1996 year.
"We are pleased that margins have held up throughout the year despite increased competition for key programming assets," chief executive officer John McAlpine said in a statement.

TEN said advertising revenue rose 16.6 percent in 1996/97 over the previous year, boosted by the inclusion of Adelaide and Perth for the full period. On a comparable basis, advertising revenue grew by 6.1 percent.
TEN, Australia's third rating commercial network, is 76 percent owned by CanWest Global Communications Corp on an economic interest basis.
